1. (Canceled)
2. (New) An electronic device for long-term adhesion, the device comprising:
a physiologic data collection circuit contained within a housing;
a skin-adhering section extending from the housing, the skin-adhering section comprising a first electrode positioned on a bottom surface of the skin-adhering section, the first electrode electrically connected to the physiologic data collection circuit;
an adhesive layer positioned on the bottom surface of the skin-adhering section;
a second electrode; and
an electrical barrier configured to protect the first electrode and the second electrode from shortage.
3. (New) The electronic device of claim 2, wherein the electrical barrier is non-conductive.
4. (New) The electronic device of claim 2, comprising a plurality of electrical barriers.
5. (New) The electronic device of claim 2, wherein the adhesive layer does not extend beneath the housing.
6. (New) The electronic device of claim 2, wherein the adhesive layer comprises a hydrocolloid adhesive.
7. (New) The electronic device of claim 2, wherein the adhesive layer extends at least partially below the housing.
8. (New) The electronic device of claim 2, wherein the skin-adhering section comprises a flap.
9. (New) The electronic device of claim 8, wherein the flap extends at least partially below the housing.
10. (New) The electronic device of claim 2, wherein the physiologic data collection circuit is configured to collect cardiac rhythm data from the user.
11. (New) The electronic device of claim 2, wherein the housing is rigid.
12. (New) An electronic device for long-term adhesion, the device comprising:
a housing;
a physiologic data collection circuit contained in the housing;
a skin-adhering section extending from the housing;
the skin-adhering section comprising an electrode positioned on a bottom surface of the skin-adhering section, the electrode electrically connected to the physiologic data collection circuit;
the skin-adhering section comprising an adhesive layer positioned over the electrode and an adhesive strip positioned over and adhered to the adhesive layer, the adhesive strip extending outward beyond a boundary of the adhesive layer.
13. (New) The electronic device of claim 12, wherein the adhesive strip is configured to protect the adhesive layer.
14. (New) The electronic device of claim 12, further comprising a skin-adhering adhesive positioned on the underside of the skin-adhering section.
15. (New) The electronic device of claim 14, wherein the skin-adhering adhesive does not extend beneath the housing.
16. (New) The electronic device of claim 14, wherein the skin-adhering adhesive comprises a hydrocolloid adhesive.
17. (New) The electronic device of claim 14, wherein the skin-adhering adhesive extends at least partially below the housing.
18. (New) The electronic device of claim 12, wherein the physiologic data collection circuit is configured to collect cardiac rhythm data from the user.
19. (New) The electronic device of claim 12, wherein the housing is rigid.
